name: Google Canelones / Project Teros data center
notes: Google lists Canelones, Uruguay as an in-development data center in the Municipality of Nicolich within Parque de las Ciencias. DCD reported construction start and an investment above US$850 million; Uruguay environmental project page describes construction and operation of a data center at Ruta 101 km 23.500. Capacity not disclosed.

name: ANTEL Data Center Ing. Jose Luis Massera / Pando
notes: ANTEL official page lists the Jose Luis Massera data center contact at Parque Industrial de Pando. CIEMSA describes the 12,500 m2 Tier III certified project; DataCenterMap lists 12 MW. Pando is in Canelones department.

name: ANTEL AI data center at Pando
notes: Presidencia reported ANTEL will implement a specialized AI data center in 2026 within the Pando infrastructure, with an estimated US$8 million investment and installation expected before year end. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Willinn by Zonamerica DC1
notes: Willinn states it operates Uruguay's private Tier III certified data center for networking and colocation. DataCenterMap places Willinn by Zonamerica DC1 at Ruta 8 Km 17.500 - Building 100, in the Canelones/Montevideo edge market.

name: SDELS Data Center
notes: Servidores del Sur advertises a managed data center in Uruguay; DataCenterMap and Datacenters.com identify SDELS Data Center at Casino Tower / Avenida Francia, Punta del Este, Maldonado. Capacity not disclosed.

name: ANTEL new Montevideo data center
notes: ANTEL announced it will begin construction between late 2026 and early 2027 on a new Montevideo data center, representing a US$70 million investment. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Latechco Aguada Park Data Center / Latechco AP
notes: Latechco says it has three interconnected data centers in Uruguay operating 24/7. Facility-specific directories place Latechco AP at Paraguay 2141, Montevideo; DataCenterMap describes it as a carrier-neutral Tier III colocation facility. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Latechco World Trade Center Montevideo Free Zone Data Center
notes: Latechco official site confirms three fiber-interconnected Uruguay data centers. Facility directories list the WTC Free Zone data center at Dr. Luis Bonavita 1294, Montevideo. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Latechco WTC Torre IV Data Center
notes: Latechco official site confirms three Uruguay data centers; facility directories list WTC Torre IV at Doctor Luis Bonavita 1266, Montevideo. Capacity not disclosed.

name: GEOCENTER
notes: DataCenterMap identifies GEOCENTER by GEOCOM Uruguay S.A. at Dionisio Oribe 3071, Montevideo. Colocation listings describe it as GEOCOM Uruguay's flagship data center with over 1,500 m2 and Tier III certification; capacity not disclosed.

name: ANTEL Data Center Pocitos
notes: DataCenterMap lists ANTEL Data Center Pocitos at Ramon Masini 3012, Montevideo, with colocation/cloud services. LACNIC reported a DNS root server copy installed at ANTEL's Pocitos Data Center due to its suitability for critical infrastructure. Capacity not disclosed.

name: ANTEL Data Center Lezama
notes: DataCenterMap identifies ANTEL Data Center Lezama at Calle Dr. Arturo Lezama 2169, Montevideo, and lists cabinet, cage, suite, build-to-suit and remote-hands services. Capacity not supplied by operator in listing.
